items.source: An implementation of both a Schema as well as a Neo4j version of Spring Data's MappingContext.
items.translation: 同时实现了 Schema 接口以及 Spring Data 的 Neo4j 版本 MappingContext。

items.source: An instance of such a provider can be registered as a Spring bean and will be consulted by the Neo4jMappingContext prior to creating and populating persistent properties.
items.translation: 此类提供者的实例可以注册为 Spring Bean，在创建和填充 Neo4jMappingContext 的 持久化属性 之前，该上下文会先咨询此类提供者。

items.source: This package contains the callback API.
A set of annotations for providing custom queries to repositories.
items.translation: 用于向仓库提供自定义查询的一组注解。

items.source:
This package provides a couple of public support classes for
building custom imperative and reactive Spring Data Neo4j repository base classes.
items.translation: 该包提供了一些公共支持类，用于构建自定义的指令式和响应式 Spring Data Neo4j 仓库基类。

items.source: Used for create statements from the (Reactive)Neo4jTemplate.
Creates a return statement for an ongoing match.
items.translation: 为进行中的比赛创建返回语句。

items.source: Executes all post load methods of the given instance.
items.translation: 执行给定实例的所有加载后方法。

items.source: Will be called after any conversion.
items.translation: 将在任何转换之后被调用。

items.source: Invoked after converting a Neo4j record (aka after hydrating an entity).
items.translation: 在将 Neo4j 记录（即实体水合）转换后调用。

items.source:
Utility method for creating a query fragment including parameters for a given
condition.
items.translation: 用于为给定条件创建包含参数的查询片段的方法。

items.source: Returns the full schema based description for the underlying entity.
items.translation: 返回底层实体的完整架构描述。
